mapper.select: select sysi.institution_name from chb_org_regist_bank_code corbc inner join sys_institution sysi on corbc.org_code=sysi.institution_code and corbc.status='E' where rownum=1

select sysi.institution_name from data_auth_notify_inst dani inner join sys_institution sysi on dani.institution_code=sysi.institution_code where dani.business_id=#{booksetOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dani.data_type=#{dataType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dani.model_type='02' and rownum=1

select distinct sysi.institution_name from sys_batch_prd_grp sbpg inner join sys_batch_grp_prdlink sbgpl on sbpg.seq_no=sbgpl.group_seq inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani on sbgpl.product_id=dani.business_id inner join sys_institution sysi on dani.institution_code=sysi.institution_code where seq_no=#{booksetOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dani.data_type=#{dataType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dani.model_type='02' and rownum=1
